muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت", referring to the Prophet ﷺ. The clause ﴿قل﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position.
﴿هو﴾: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الله﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, or a second mubtadaʾ, nominative by the ḍamma.
﴿أحد﴾: naʿt (adjective) of الله, or the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, in which case the clause ﴿الله أحد﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿هو الله﴾ is in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿الصمد﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative. The clause ﴿الله الصمد﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) هو.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿يلد﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو", referring to Allah the Exalted. The clause is in the position of the nominative (marfūʿ) as a third khabar (predicate) of the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) هو.
﴿ولم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لم is a particle of negation, of conversion and of the jussive, indeclinable on the sukūn.
﴿يولد﴾: an imperfect verb, passive, jussive by لم, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent, its implied form being "هو", referring to Allah the Exalted. The clause is in the position of the nominative by conjunction to the clause لم يلد.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ولم﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; لم: a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿يكن﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كفوا﴾.
﴿كفوا﴾: the fronted khabar (predicate) of يكن, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿أحد﴾: the delayed noun of يكن, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma. The clause is in the position of the nominative by conjunction to the clause ﴿لم يلد﴾.
